title: Moises NDE 5389
content: I was riding a motorbike without any helmet on. I halted at a Stop sign and a car hit me (from behind). It was going fast and threw me 12 to 15 meters. I flew over the car and fell; hitting the ground with my head. Then I started to feel really cold, as if my skin had been ripped off. I began to float and got really scared when I looked at my hands but they weren't there and neither were my feet. As I was very cold, I got even more scared and I looked down and saw my body on the ground on its side with people saying that I had been killed. I heard and saw the people. I also recognized them, as the accident was on my own street. So then I spoke to them from above, saying I was not dead, but they didn't hear me. I wasn't moving, my body did not move, though I was floating. I tried to come back down to my body but I couldn't because something was pulling me upwards. The cold continued and a very intense and dazzling yellow light appeared, along with a strong wind, with a loud noise of wind. I started to enter this light-tunnel, but before going into it, I looked down and said (to the people there) that I was up above. I thought about my mother and my family before I entered the light and I could see a boy come running up and start to administer CPR to my body. I said to him I was up above already but he went on doing it without pausing. Then I entered the light and the cold went away from me, and so did the fear. I felt a great peace and love. It was love and warmth. The light enveloped me completely. I was spoken to telepathically, receiving peace, love, tranquility and at the same time in a voiceless communication. I was still a bit sad, thinking that I wanted to be with my family who loved me so much. My family was still on earth, back home, waiting for me so we could eat together. Then suddenly the wind returned, the light went away, and I began to cough; back in my body. I could not see but I felt my fingers and arms and knew that I had come back into my body thanks to the boy who resuscitated me. I opened my eyes but it was some minutes before I could see. I got up then and fell over again, feeling dizzy. On the ground, I was conscious of everything, trembling with fear at having been outside my body, and I said, thinking of the light, 'Thank you for letting me come back to my family.'

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Intense cold, 'as if my skin had been ripped off'; being pulled upwards.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Strong wind with a loud wind noise; entered a 'light-tunnel'.

environment.environment_other_detail: Dazzling yellow light that enveloped him; strong wind.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Motorbike stopped at a stop sign; hit from behind by a fast car; thrown 12–15 meters; head hit the ground; resuscitated with CPR.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Strong wind and loud wind noise; intense cold that ceased upon entering the light; observed CPR being administered to his body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with observation of body and scene, then pulled upward; dazzling yellow light and wind; entered light-tunnel; telepathic/voiceless communication; then wind returned and he re-entered his body coughing.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Noted absence of hands/feet while out of body; intense cold 'as if my skin had been ripped off' prior to entering the light; loud wind accompanying the light/tunnel.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I started to feel really cold, as if my skin had been ripped off.”; “a very intense and dazzling yellow light appeared, along with a strong wind, with a loud noise of wind.”; “I felt a great peace and love.”; “I was spoken to telepathically… in a voiceless communication.”; “Thank you for letting me come back to my family.”
